purpose: Developer schema semantics, not owner facts, not customer-question aliases

accessibility.description_en: Access provisions and assistance for people with disabilities or wheelchair users.

age_rating.description_en: Published game age classification, distinct from the venue admission policy.

amount_minor.description_en: Price or fee in minor currency units; zero means confirmed free use.

audience_id.description_en: Visitor group or organization to which this price or package applies.

audience_ids.description_en: Visitor groups eligible for the event.

bindings.description_en: Which buttons or inputs trigger each action, how to press them and the gameplay context.

body.description_en: Information or message announced in this news item.

bookable_periods.description_en: Periods when a play slot can be reserved or played.

booking_product_key.description_en: Verified product identifier used by the reservation API.

building.description_en: Building or tower where the center is located.

calculation_rule.description_en: Approved arithmetic rule, such as proportional or fixed pricing; do not invent multipliers.

capacity_max.description_en: Largest group allowed in this service.

capacity_min.description_en: Fewest participants required for this service.

capacity_persons.description_en: Maximum simultaneous users on this physical station; not room seating.

channel.description_en: Communication channel type, such as phone, email, website or on-site desk.

competition_dates.description_en: Dates when this competition is held.

competition_id.description_en: Tournament rulebook to which this clause belongs.

completeness.description_en: Whether this individual rule clause has been checked as complete.

conditions_all.description_en: Conditions that must all be satisfied.

consequence.description_en: Confirmed penalty or consequence of breaking the policy.

contact_id.description_en: Contact channel for the announced activity.

coverage.description_en: Whether the full rulebook documentation is complete.

decision.description_en: Whether the behavior is permitted, forbidden, required or conditional.

depends_on_ids.description_en: Related rule clauses and exceptions that must be read together.

description.description_en: Purpose and scope of this venue or zone.

details.description_en: Full policy wording with its conditions.

device_type.description_en: Category of hardware, such as computer, console, VR headset or racing wheel.

display_name.description_en: Name of the person approved for public display.

duration_minutes.description_en: Confirmed duration covered by this price or rental package, in minutes.

eligibility.description_en: Who qualifies to belong to this visitor or pricing group.

equipment_included.description_en: Equipment or kit and quantities included in the rental package.

equipment_model_ids.description_en: Hardware models making up this resource.

event_end.description_en: Date and time when the announced event finishes.

event_name.description_en: Name and year of the competition.

event_start.description_en: Date and time when the announced event begins.

exceptions.description_en: Exceptions to the restriction or requirements.

external_resource_key.description_en: Verified resource identifier used by the provider API.

freshness_policy.description_en: Approved age limit, cache lifetime or expiry rule for live data.

game_id.description_en: Game to which this installation, mode, control scheme or tournament belongs.

how_to_play.description_en: Game objective and basic actions or gameplay loop; how a beginner starts and progresses. Not a full walkthrough or guaranteed winning strategy.

input_device.description_en: Type of controller or input device.

installed_resource_ids.description_en: Specific physical stations on which this game is confirmed installed.

limitations.description_en: Known limitations of this control scheme or unconfirmed actions.

local_date.description_en: Calendar date affected, in the local time zone.

location.description_en: Position of this zone or amenity inside the venue.

maintenance_periods.description_en: Maintenance periods during which booking is blocked.

map_url.description_en: Link to a map showing the location.

mode_name.description_en: Name of the local or online game mode.

network_requirement.description_en: Internet, network or account requirements of this mode.

occupancy_minutes.description_en: Time the physical device is reserved or blocked by a booking, in minutes; may exceed actual play time.

offered.description_en: Whether this game is actually offered through the specified venue service.

office_hours.description_en: Hours during which staff respond through this contact channel.

open_periods.description_en: Periods when visitors may enter the venue.

operational_status.description_en: Whether the equipment is physically in service, out of service or retired; not a live booking status.

operator.description_en: Organization that owns or operates the center.

outcome.description_en: Confirmed outcome of following this procedure.

period_label.description_en: Package label such as half day or full day; does not itself confirm a duration.

persons_max.description_en: Maximum group size covered by this price.

persons_min.description_en: Minimum group size covered by this price.

physical_pool_key.description_en: Identifier of the shared physical resource pool used by overlapping booking products.

platform.description_en: Device platform for this service, mode or control scheme.

players_max.description_en: Largest number of players supported by this game mode; not service or room capacity.

players_min.description_en: Smallest number of players required for this game mode.

preconditions.description_en: Situations to which the procedure applies.

preset.description_en: Name of the control layout or profile.

public_contact_id.description_en: Public work contact for the person.

public_scope.description_en: Information about the person approved for public release; never customer private data.

purpose.description_en: Issues that this support channel can help with.

question.description_en: Question associated with this FAQ record.

reason.description_en: Reason for the announced hours or closure.

related_ids.description_en: Other catalog records related to this FAQ.

required_documents.description_en: Paperwork or evidence to prepare for this process.

required_proofs.description_en: Evidence, identity cards or documents a visitor must present to prove membership or eligibility.

resolution_policy_id.description_en: Policy for handling reservations affected by a closure.

resource_ids.description_en: Physical stations used by this bookable service.

role.description_en: What this person is responsible for, including duties and position.

room_seats.description_en: Total visitor seats in this area; not the number of people playing on a single device.

rulebook_release.description_en: Edition or version of the rulebook governing this tournament.

scope_note.description_en: Situations to which this answer applies and its limitations.

service_id.description_en: Bookable service to which this installation, price or live binding belongs.

session_minutes.description_en: Actual playing time provided by one service session, in minutes.

specifications.description_en: Hardware features, components, sizes, models and their units.

state.description_en: Closure or opening exception status: closed, modified hours or special opening override.

status_mapping.description_en: Meaning or translation of the provider status codes.

steps.description_en: Ordered actions to carry out the process and get help.

studio_supported.description_en: Whether the venue actually supports this mode.

subject.description_en: Object or behavior governed by this policy.

summary.description_en: What the game is about: theme or premise.

supersedes_id.description_en: Earlier revision replaced by this record.

supported_platforms.description_en: Platforms the game supports in general; not proof that the venue offers it.

tax_note.description_en: Tax treatment and related price conditions.

team.description_en: Team or organization to which the person belongs.

terms.description_en: Other confirmed package conditions or extra charges.

text.description_en: Entire wording of this rule clause, including qualifying conditions; not rulebook metadata.

timezone.description_en: Time zone used to interpret dates and times.

title.description_en: Official title of a game or announcement.

topic.description_en: Semantic subject of this policy, procedure or FAQ.

unit.description_en: Charging unit: what one quoted price pays for, such as a session, hour or person.

usage.description_en: Instructions for operating this physical equipment.

usage_conditions.description_en: Conditions that must be met to use this amenity.

value.description_en: Actual contact address, phone number or URL used to reach help.

weekday.description_en: Day of the week in the catalog encoding.

zone_ids.description_en: Zones covered by this package, schedule or closure.
